prior_hypothesis.hypothesis: Random normal-axis augmentation can improve selected original CV yet its fixed M6 mixture did not reliably improve fresh-partition M6. Test structured worst-case rather than stochastic normal-direction robustness. This uses known adversarial feature training; do not claim PCA or FGSM invention or assume every normal direction is acquisition noise.
prior_hypothesis.geometry: Unchanged fit-only normalization and equal normal-patient centroid PCA32 for all four streams. Base input is deterministic full normal-reference projection. Axis amplitude uses sqrt(sample eigenvalue). Refit geometry independently per patient phase; freeze before head fitting.
prior_hypothesis.architecture: Original attentionMLP full M5 objective. For every training batch compute clean objective and an additional full objective at post-projection rank32 coordinate perturbations. Rademacher controls use private independent random signs. FGSM uses sign of the full clean-objective gradient with respect to zero normal coordinates, detached before second pass. Perturbation per image/stream is epsilon*sqrt(normal eigenvalue)*sign, uniformly shared across regional tokens. Loss=.5clean+.5perturbed. No perturbation or attack at stopping/outer inference. Keep original optimizer,patientweights,head initialization and early stopping.
prior_hypothesis.rng: Private NumPy signs RNG20282124+model_seed; both modes draw identical sign arrays, FGSM uses detached gradient sign. Save CPU/CUDA states immediately before clean forward and replay the perturbed forward in fork_rng with exactly the same dropout masks; only clean forward advances the global RNG. No additional parameters or initialization RNG draws.
prior_hypothesis.fixed_fusions: Also evaluate only predeclared .25 originalM5+.75newbranch mixtures, no extra fusion fits. Do not tune weights using confirmation or external outcomes.
prior_hypothesis.preflight_required: Independent coordinate/sign and objective reconstruction; zero epsilon clean original loss/predictions; infinitesimal FGSM directional derivative nonnegative with controlled dropout; correct axis bounds and uniform region shift; no gradient through detached adversarial direction; gradients through both full losses; real256-image updates, strict recovery, private RNG and fit-only witnesses. Record actual first training batch and perturbation witnesses.
prior_hypothesis.selection: Highest passing original CV candidate freezes before unused patient-partition confirmation against M6/M5/fixedGaussian; confirmation seeds20271101/20271111 are now used and cannot be called fresh again. No automatic external scoring.
prior_hypothesis.witness: First actual training batch: raw global vectors for all256 samples, first8allstreams, complete labels/weights, clean/perturbed probabilities and losses, all128coordinate gradients/directions/attacks, initial parameter SHA256 and clean CPU/CUDA RNG. Independently reconstruct CUDA first randperm from original model seed, initial weights, NumPy projection, full losses and gradients with plain M5 and saved dropout RNG.
